svg.text: Real-Time Per-Tenant Rule Matching with Flink Broadcast State
Confluent Platform for Flink (self-managed) + Confluent Cloud
Confluent Platform for Flink (CMF) • self-managed on Kubernetes
fetch content directly — async, on demand, never through Kafka
Only a URI notification and the filtered match set ever reach Kafka.
Blob content never lands in a topic; matching is scoped to each event’s own tenant, never the full rule set loaded into the job.
Adding a rule, editing one, or onboarding a new tenant is a message into broadcast state — never a redeploy.
